svg.title: Gaussian Transform
svg.desc: Three histograms showing why the Extended Kalman Filter is needed. First, Gaussian samples centered at 0, spanning about minus 4 to 4. Second, the same samples after the linear transform 2x: still a bell-shaped Gaussian centered at 0, but twice as wide, spanning about minus 8 to 8. Third, after the nonlinear transform sine of x: confined to minus 1 to 1, nearly flat in the middle with tall spikes at both ends, so it is no longer Gaussian.
